summary: Feature implemented but not verified: I could not run tests or flake8 under the no-execution constraint, so the checks were limited to reading the code and grep-based checks for line length, trailing whitespace, final newlines, and unused imports. Changes: new monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver); plot_2d_or_3d_image added to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py; SegmentationSaver and ClassificationSaver rewritten as thin delegating handlers, with the classification handler registering an engine-accepting finalize wrapper; TensorBoardImageHandler gained index and delegates to the plot function; NIfTI writer default dtype changed to np.float32; output_path renamed to output_dir in two examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py. Tests added: test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py; test_handler_classification_saver.py updated to pass filename. Nothing committed. Next step: run the listed pytest files and flake8 on the changed files.
